item.title: Knightica
item.description: Recruit units, place them strategically, and find the synergies in this Roguelike AutoBattler! Knightica lets you guide a warband through challenges to free the Kingdoms. Discover combinations, weave powerful enchants, face dangerous monsters, and lead your army to victory!
